answer: Farming becomes an orchard bet on surviving 69 epochs of grading, and every mesa settlement recomputes the ridge schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 69 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
